# FunkyCommerce — full content summary (llms-full.txt)
#
# Placeholder for the expanded llms.txt companion file. In production the WP backend
# should generate this from live catalog/blog/taxonomy data (per-file enable/disable
# toggle, per the product spec) — this static stand-in exists so the route/link from
# llms.txt resolves during frontend-only development.

FunkyCommerce is a headless WooCommerce storefront selling apparel and accessories,
with an editorial blog and a creator marketplace where approved users can sell their
own listings alongside a Pinterest/Instagram-style community feed.

This file intentionally has no generated catalog data yet — no backend is connected
in this build. Once WPGraphQL is wired up, this route should be regenerated per the
backend's periodic-rebuild schedule (see the "Periodic Rebuild with CRON" option in
the headless options screen) with real product names, categories, and prices.
